units.zh: 天福三年正月戊申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。
units.en: On the first day of the first month of Tianfu 3, the emperor entered Chongyuan Hall to receive the New Year court congratulations, with guards and ceremonial escorts in full order.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianfu, first month, on the first day of the month (wushen), the Emperor took the throne in Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and escorts followed the prescribed form.

units.zh: 己酉，百官守司，以太史先奏日蝕故也。
units.en: On jiyou the officials remained at their posts, since the court astrologer had already forecast an eclipse of the sun.
units.literal: On jiyou, the hundred officials kept their posts, because the Grand Astrologer had beforehand reported a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 至是不虧，內外稱賀。
units.en: When the moment came, the sun was not dimmed, and court and capital alike offered congratulations.
units.literal: When it came to this, there was no eclipse; inside and outside offered congratulations.

units.zh: 壬戌，是夜以上元張燈於京城，縱都人遊樂，帝御大寧宮門樓觀之。
units.en: On renxu, that night the capital was hung with lanterns for the Lantern Festival, the people of the city were allowed to roam and celebrate, and the emperor took the gate tower of Daning Palace to watch.
units.literal: On renxu, that night for the Upper Yuan Festival lamps were displayed in the capital, the metropolitan populace was allowed to revel, and the Emperor mounted the gate tower of Daning Palace to observe.

units.zh: 丙寅，端明殿學士、禮部侍郎和凝兼判度支；
units.en: On bingyin, He Ning, academician of the Duanming Hall and vice minister of rites, was also put in charge of the revenue bureau;
units.literal: On bingyin, Academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of Rites He Ning was additionally appointed to oversee the Department of Revenue;

units.zh: 工部侍郎、判度支王松改尚書刑部侍郎；
units.en: Wang Song, vice minister of works and acting revenue overseer, was reassigned as vice minister of punishments in the Department of State Affairs;
units.literal: Vice Minister of Works and overseer of revenue Wang Song was changed to Vice Minister of Punishments in the Department of State Affairs;

units.zh: 戶部郎中高延賞改左諫議大夫，充諸道鹽鐵轉運副使。
units.en: Gao Yanshang, director in the ministry of revenue, became left remonstrance counselor and deputy commissioner for salt and iron transport on all circuits.
units.literal: Director of the Ministry of Revenue Gao Yanshang was changed to Left Remonstrance Counselor and appointed Deputy Commissioner for Salt and Iron Transport on all circuits.

units.zh: 壬申，以前右諫議大夫薛融為左諫議大夫。
units.en: On renshen the former right remonstrance counselor Xue Rong was made left remonstrance counselor.
units.literal: On renshen, the former Right Remonstrance Counselor Xue Rong was appointed Left Remonstrance Counselor.

units.zh: 前興元節度使張筠卒於西京，輟視朝一日。
units.en: Zhang Yun, former military commissioner of Xingyuan, died in the Western Capital, and court audiences were suspended for one day.
units.literal: The former Military Commissioner of Xingyuan Zhang Yun died in the Western Capital; court audiences were suspended for one day.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：太常禮院申：「準故事，前節度使無例輟朝。」
units.en: (From the Institutes of the Five Dynasties: the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "According to precedent, there is no example of suspending court for a former military commissioner."
units.literal: (From the Institutes of the Five Dynasties: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "According to precedent, there is no example of suspending court for a former military commissioner."

units.zh: 敕：「宜特輟一日朝參。」）〉
units.en: An edict replied: "Court attendance shall be specially suspended for one day.")〉
units.literal: Edict: "A one-day suspension of court attendance is hereby specially granted.")〉

units.zh: 二月庚辰，左散騎常侍張允進《駁赦論》。
units.en: On gengchen in the second month, Zhang Yun, left regular attendant, presented "A Discourse Against Indiscriminate Amnesties."
units.literal: In the second month, on gengchen, Left Regular Attendant Zhang Yun submitted "A Discourse Refuting Amnesties."

units.zh: 帝覽而嘉之，降詔獎飾，仍付史館。
units.en: The emperor read it with approval, issued an edict of commendation, and ordered it deposited in the historiography institute.
units.literal: The Emperor read it and commended it, issued an edict of reward and decoration, and had it sent to the Historiography Institute.

units.zh: 甲申，荊南節度使高從誨加食邑實封。
units.en: On jiashen the Jingnan military commissioner Gao Conghui received additional fief income and substantive enfeoffment.
units.literal: On jiashen, the Jingnan Military Commissioner Gao Conghui was granted additional fief lands and substantive enfeoffment.

units.zh: 戊子，翰林學士李浣賜緋魚袋。
units.en: On wuzi the Hanlin academician Li Huan was granted the crimson robe and fish tally of office.
units.literal: On wuzi, the Hanlin Academician Li Huan was granted the crimson robe and fish tally.

units.zh: 以尚書屯田員外郎、知制誥吳承範為庫部員外郎，充樞密院直學士。
units.en: Wu Chengfan, vice director of the Tuntian (military-farms) bureau and drafter of edicts, was made vice director of the armory bureau and direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: The Vice Director of the Tuntian Bureau and Drafter of Edicts Wu Chengfan was appointed Vice Director of the Armory and direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 乙未，御劄曰：「曾有宣示百官，令進封事，今據到者未及十人。
units.en: On yiwei an imperial communication said: "We once announced to the whole bureaucracy that sealed memorials should be submitted; fewer than ten have arrived.
units.literal: On yiwei, an Imperial Communication stated: "There was once an announcement to the hundred officials ordering them to submit sealed memorials; those received now number fewer than ten persons.

units.zh: 朕雖無德，自行敕後已是數月，至於假手於人，也合各有一件事敷奏。
units.en: Though We are without merit, several months have passed since the edict went out; even those who act through deputies ought each to have brought one matter before the throne.
units.literal: Though We lack virtue, since issuing the edict it has already been several months; as for delegating to others, each should have had one matter to present at court.

units.zh: 食祿於朝，豈當如是！
units.en: To draw salary from the court and behave thus—how can that be right!
units.literal: Receiving salary from the court—how can it be like this!

units.zh: 言而不用，朕所甘心；
units.en: If We hear counsel and do not take it, We can accept that;
units.literal: If words are not heeded, We willingly accept that;

units.zh: 用而不言，誰之責也。」
units.en: but if counsel is needed and none is offered—whose fault is that?"
units.literal: If they are not spoken when used—whose responsibility is that?"

units.zh: 丙申，制武清軍節度使馬希萼改威武軍節度使。
units.en: On bingshen an order named Ma Xi'e, military commissioner of the Wuqing army, as military commissioner of the Weiwu army instead.
units.literal: On bingshen, an order was issued that Ma Xiege, Military Commissioner of the Wuqing Army, be changed to Military Commissioner of the Weiwu Army.

units.zh: 辛丑，中書上言：「《禮經》云：『禮不諱嫌名，二名不偏諱。』
units.en: On xinchou the Secretariat reported: "The Classic of Rites states: 'Ritual does not require avoidance of homophonic names, and for double names one does not avoid only one character.'
units.literal: On xinchou, the Secretariat reported: "The Classic of Rites says: 'In ritual one does not avoid homophonic names; for double names one does not avoid using only part.'

units.zh: 註云：『嫌名，謂音聲相近，若禹與宇、邱與區也。
units.en: The commentary explains: 'Homophonic names' means names that sound alike, as Yu and yu, or Qiu and qu.
units.literal: The commentary says: 'Homophonic names' means similar sounds, as Yu and yu, Qiu and qu.

units.zh: 二名不偏諱，謂孔子之母名徵在，言在不稱徵，言徵不稱在。』
units.en: Not avoiding only part of a double name means that when Confucius's mother was named Zhengzai, one did not say zheng when speaking of zai, nor zai when speaking of zheng.
units.literal: Not avoiding only part of a double name means Confucius's mother's name was Zhengzai—in speech one does not say zheng when saying zai, and does not say zai when saying zheng.

units.zh: 此古禮也。
units.en: This was the ancient rule.
units.literal: This is ancient ritual.

units.zh: 唐太宗二名並諱，玄宗二名亦同；
units.en: Emperor Taizong of Tang tabooed both characters of his double name, and Emperor Xuanzong did the same;
units.literal: Emperor Taizong of Tang avoided both characters of his double name, and Emperor Xuanzong did likewise;

units.zh: 人姓與國諱音聲相近是嫌名者，亦改姓氏，與古禮有異。
units.en: surnames that sounded like the dynastic taboo were also changed, which diverges from the ancient practice.
units.literal: For surnames homophonic with the dynastic taboo—homophonic names—surnames too were changed, which differs from ancient ritual.

units.zh: 廟諱平聲字，即不諱余三聲；
units.en: When the temple taboo is a level-tone character, the other three tones of that syllable need not be avoided;
units.literal: For temple taboo level-tone characters, the other three tones are not tabooed;

units.zh: 諱側聲，即不諱平聲字。
units.en: when the taboo is an oblique tone, the level-tone form need not be avoided.
units.literal: when the taboo is an oblique tone, level-tone characters are not tabooed.

units.zh: 所諱字正文及偏旁闕點畫，望依令式施行。」
units.en: For tabooed characters in formal writing and in radicals, strokes should be omitted as regulations prescribe; we ask that this be enforced according to statute."
units.literal: For tabooed characters in formal text and radicals, omit strokes as prescribed—we request implementation per regulations."

units.zh: 詔曰：「朝廷之制，今古相沿，道在人宏，禮非天降。
units.en: An edict replied: "Court institutions are transmitted from age to age; the Way is enlarged by human effort, and ritual does not fall from heaven.
units.literal: Edict: "Court institutions are handed down through ages; the Way lies in people's enlargement—ritual does not descend from heaven.

units.zh: 方開歷數，虔奉祖宗，雖逾孔子之文，未爽周公之訓。
units.en: As We inaugurate Our dynasty and reverently serve the ancestors, though We go beyond Confucius's wording, We do not depart from the Duke of Zhou's teaching.
units.literal: As We inaugurate the succession and reverently serve the ancestors, though exceeding Confucius's text, We have not departed from the Duke of Zhou's instruction.

units.zh: 所為二名及嫌名事，宜依唐禮施行。」
units.en: Matters of double names and homophonic names shall be carried out according to Tang ritual."
units.literal: Matters of double names and homophonic names shall follow Tang ritual."

units.zh: 〈（案：太原縣有史匡翰碑，立於天福八年。
units.en: (Note: Taiyuan County has a stele to Shi Kuanghan, erected in Tianfu 8.
units.literal: (Note: In Taiyuan County there is a stele for Shi Kuanghan, erected in the eighth year of Tianfu.

units.zh: 匡翰，建瑭之子也。
units.en: Kuanghan was the son of Jiantang.
units.literal: Kuanghan was the son of Jiantang.

units.zh: 碑於「瑭」字空文以避諱，而建瑭父敬思，仍書「敬」字，蓋當時避諱之體如此。）〉
units.en: On the stele the character for "tang" is left blank to observe taboo, yet Jiantang's father Jingsi is still written with the character "jing"—such was how taboo was practiced at the time.)〉
units.literal: On the stele the character tang is left blank in the text to avoid taboo, yet Jiantang's father Jingsi still has the character jing written—such was the form of taboo avoidance at that time.)〉

units.zh: 乙巳，天和節，宴近臣於廣政殿。
units.en: On yisi, the Tianhe festival, the emperor feasted his close ministers in Guangzheng Hall.
units.literal: On yisi, the Tianhe Festival, a banquet for close ministers was held in Guangzheng Hall.

units.zh: 三月戊午，鴻臚卿劉頎卒，贈太子賓客。
units.en: On wuwu in the third month, Liu Qi, director of the Court for Dependencies, died and was posthumously made Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: In the third month, on wuwu, Director of the Court for Dependencies Liu Qi died and was posthumously granted Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 壬戌，東上閣門使、前司農卿蘇繼顏改鴻臚卿充職。
units.en: On renxu, Su Jiyan, Eastern Upper Gate commissioner and former director of agriculture, was transferred to director of the Court for Dependencies with concurrent duty.
units.literal: On renxu, Su Jiyan, Commissioner of the Eastern Upper Gate and former Director of the Directorate of Agriculture, was changed to Director of the Court for Dependencies with concurrent duty.

units.zh: 回鶻可汗王仁美進野馬、獨峰駝、玉團、碙砂等方物。
units.en: Uyghur qaghan Renmei presented wild horses, dromedaries, jade orbs, sal ammoniac, and other tribute goods.
units.literal: The Uyghur qaghan Renmei presented wild horses, single-hump camels, jade orbs, sal ammoniac, and other local products.

units.zh: 甲戌，永壽長公主薨，輟朝一日。
units.en: On jiaxu Princess Yongshou died, and court audiences were suspended for one day.
units.literal: On jiaxu, Princess Yongshou died; court audiences were suspended for one day.

units.zh: 故涇州節度觀察留後盧順密贈右驍衛上將軍。
units.en: Lu Shunmi, late acting Jing military commissioner, was posthumously made Senior General of the Right Brave Guard.
units.literal: The late acting military commissioner of Jing, Lu Shunmi, was posthumously granted Senior General of the Right Brave Guard.

units.zh: 丁丑，詔禁止私下打造鑄瀉銅器。
units.en: On dingchou an edict forbade the private forging and casting of copper vessels.
units.literal: On dingchou, an edict prohibited privately forging and casting copper vessels.

units.zh: 四月丁亥，以尚書吏部侍郎盧詹為尚書左丞。
units.en: On dinghai in the fourth month, Lu Zhan, vice minister of personnel, was made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: In the fourth month, on dinghai, Vice Minister of Personnel Lu Zhan was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 中書舍人李詳上疏：「請沙汰在朝文武臣僚，以減冗食。
units.en: Palace draftsman Li Xiang memorialized: "We ask that civil and military officials at court be screened and culled to reduce redundant stipends.
units.literal: Palace Draftsman Li Xiang submitted a memorial: "We request screening out civil and military officials at court to reduce redundant salaries.

units.zh: 仍條貫藩侯郡守，凡遇傅恩，不得多奏衙前職員，妄邀恩澤。」
units.en: Regulations should also bind feudatory lords and prefects: whenever favors are distributed, they must not flood the court with requests for yamen staff, seeking rewards without cause."
units.literal: Also set regulations for feudatory lords and prefectural governors: whenever conferring favors, they must not excessively memorialize yamen staff for posts, vainly seeking grace."

units.zh: 疏奏，嘉之。
units.en: The memorial was received and commended.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted, it was commended.

units.zh: 戊子，宣武軍節度、侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、廣晉府行營都招討使楊光遠加兼中書令。
units.en: On wuzi Yang Guangyuan, military commissioner of Xuanwu, commander of the palace guard horse and foot, and grand pacification commissioner of the Guangjin field headquarters, was also made chief councilor.
units.literal: On wuzi, Yang Guangyuan—Military Commissioner of the Xuanwu Army, Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, and Grand Pacification Commissioner of the Guangjin Prefecture Field Headquarters—was additionally appointed Chief Councilor.

units.zh: 昭義節度使、侍衛馬軍都指揮使、廣晉府行營都排陣使杜重威，河陽節度使兼奉國左右廂都指揮使、廣晉府行營馬步都虞候侯益，並加檢校太傅。
units.en: Du Chongwei, military commissioner of Zhaoyi, cavalry commander of the palace guard, and chief array marshal of the Guangjin headquarters, and Hou Yi, military commissioner of Heyang, commander of the Fengguo wings, and horse-and-foot chief adjutant of the Guangjin headquarters, were both made honorary grand mentors.
units.literal: Du Chongwei—Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi, Commander of the Palace Guard Cavalry, and Chief Array Marshal of the Guangjin Field Headquarters—and Hou Yi—Military Commissioner of Heyang, Commander of the Left and Right Wings of the Fengguo Army, and Horse and Foot Chief Adjutant of the Guangjin Field Headquarters—were both promoted to Honorary Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 鳳翔節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、岐王李從嚴進封秦王，平盧軍節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令、臨淄王王建立進封東平王。
units.en: Li Congyan of Fengxiang, honorary Grand Preceptor and chief councilor, prince of Qi, was raised to prince of Qin; Wang Jianli of Pinglu, honorary Grand Commandant and chief councilor, prince of Linzi, was raised to prince of Dongping.
units.literal: Li Congyan, Military Commissioner of Fengxiang, Honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrent Chief Councilor, and Prince of Qi, was advanced to Prince of Qin; Wang Jianli, Military Commissioner of the Pinglu Army, Honorary Grand Commandant, concurrent Chief Councilor, and Prince of Linzi, was advanced to Prince of Dongping.

units.zh: 甲午，泰寧軍節度使李從溫、西京留守京兆尹李周、歸德軍節度使趙在禮，並加兼侍中。
units.en: On jiawu Li Congwen of Taining, Li Zhou, regent of the Western Capital and metropolitan governor of Jingzhao, and Zhao Zaili of Guide were all also made vice grand councilors.
units.literal: On jiawu, Li Congwen, Military Commissioner of the Taining Army; Li Zhou, Western Capital Regent and Metropolitan Governor of Jingzhao; and Zhao Zaili, Military Commissioner of the Guide Army, were all additionally appointed Vice Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 是月，諸道藩侯郡守皆等第加恩。
units.en: That month every feudatory lord and prefect on the circuits received graded favors.
units.literal: That month, feudatory lords and prefectural governors on all circuits received graded favors.

units.zh: 改雍熙樓為章和樓，避廟諱也。
units.en: Yongxi Tower was renamed Zhanghe Tower to avoid the temple taboo.
units.literal: Yongxi Tower was renamed Zhanghe Tower, to avoid the temple taboo.

units.zh: 五月丁未朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，仗衛如式。
units.en: On the first day of the fifth month the emperor entered Chongyuan Hall for court, with guards and ceremonial escorts in full order.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day (dingwei), the Emperor took the throne in Chongyuan Hall to receive court, guards and escorts following the prescribed form.

units.zh: 丁巳，詔應諸州縣名犯廟諱者並改之。
units.en: On dingsi an edict ordered that every prefecture and county whose name violated the temple taboo be renamed.
units.literal: On dingsi, an edict ordered that all prefecture and county names violating the temple taboo be changed.

units.zh: 庚申，以楊光遠男承祚為檢校工部尚書、左威衛將軍、駙馬都尉。
units.en: On gengshen Yang Guangyuan's son Chengzuo was made honorary minister of works, general of the Left Weiwu guard, and commandant of the imperial sons-in-law.
units.literal: On gengshen, Yang Guangyuan's son Chengzuo was appointed Honorary Minister of Works, General of the Left Weiwu Guard, and Commandant of the Imperial Sons-in-Law.

units.zh: 丁卯，魏府行營步軍都指揮使、檢校司徒、右神武統軍王周加檢校太保。
units.en: On dingmao Wang Zhou, foot commander of the Weifu field headquarters, honorary minister of education, and commander of the Right Shenwu army, was made honorary grand guardian.
units.literal: On dingmao, Wang Zhou—Commander of the Foot Soldiers of the Weifu Field Headquarters, Honorary Minister of Education, and Commander of the Right Shenwu Army—was promoted to Honorary Grand Guardian.

units.zh: 戊辰，故振武節度使李嗣本贈太尉。
units.en: On wuchen the late military commissioner of Zhenwu, Li Siben, was posthumously granted grand commandant.
units.literal: On wuchen, the late Military Commissioner of Zhenwu Li Siben was posthumously granted Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 己巳，詔：「中外臣僚，帶平章事、侍中、中書令及諸道節度使，並許私門立戟，仍並官給及據官品依令式處分。」
units.en: On jisi an edict declared: "Officials within and without the court who bore the titles of grand councilor, vice grand councilor, or chief councilor, and all circuit military commissioners, might erect halberds at their private gates, with state issue and disposition according to rank and statute."
units.literal: On jisi, an edict stated: "Civil and military officials within and without who hold the titles of Grand Councilor, Vice Grand Councilor, or Chief Councilor, and military commissioners on all circuits, are all permitted to set up halberds at their private gates; halberds shall also be supplied by the state, and disposition shall follow rank according to regulations."

units.zh: 六月丁丑，右監門衛上將軍王彥璘卒。
units.en: On dingchou in the sixth month Wang Yanlin, senior general of the Right Gate guard, died.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on dingchou, Senior General of the Right Gate Guard Wang Yanlin died.

units.zh: 甲申，以太子詹事王居敏制置安邑、解縣兩池榷鹽事。
units.en: On jiashen Wang Jumin, chief of the household of the heir apparent, was put in charge of the monopoly salt administration at the Anyi and Jie pools.
units.literal: On jiashen, Wang Jumin, Chief of the Household of the Heir Apparent, was appointed to oversee the monopoly salt administration of the Anyi and Jie county pools.

units.zh: 左諫議大夫薛融上疏，請停修洛京大內。
units.en: Xue Rong, left remonstrance counselor, memorialized asking that work on the great inner palace at Luoyang be halted.
units.literal: Left Remonstrance Counselor Xue Rong submitted a memorial requesting cessation of repairs to the great inner palace at Luoyang.

units.zh: 優詔褒之，尋罷營造。
units.en: A gracious edict praised him, and construction was soon stopped.
units.literal: A gracious edict commended him, and construction was soon halted.

units.zh: 庚寅，翰林學士、尚書者工部郎中、知制誥竇貞固改中書舍人充職。
units.en: On gengyin Dou Zhengu, Hanlin academician, director in the ministry of works, and drafting official, was reassigned as palace draftsman in that capacity.
units.literal: On gengyin, Dou Zhengu—Hanlin Academician, Director in the Ministry of Works, and Drafting Official—was changed to Palace Draftsman to fill the post.

units.zh: 戶部尚書致仕蕭蘧卒，贈右僕射。
units.en: Xiao Qu, retired minister of revenue, died and was posthumously granted right vice director of the department of state affairs.
units.literal: Xiao Qu, retired Minister of Revenue, died and was posthumously granted Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 詔貢舉宜權停一年，以員闕少而選人多，常調有淹滯故也。
units.en: An edict suspended the civil examinations for one year, since vacancies were scarce, candidates numerous, and regular appointees long delayed.
units.literal: An edict ordered that the civil service examinations be provisionally suspended for one year, because vacancies were few while candidates were many, and regular appointees were backing up.

units.zh: 丁酉，詔：「尚書司門應管諸闕令丞等，宜準唐天成四年四月四日敕，本司不得差補，只委闕鎮使鈐轄，見差補者，並畫時勒停訖奏聞。
units.en: On dingyou an edict ruled: "Vacant director and assistant posts under the Secretariat's Gate Office should follow the Tang edict of Tiancheng 4, 4/4: the parent bureau must not fill them itself but only the frontier commissioner of the vacancy; any already appointed must cease at once and report.
units.literal: On dingyou, an edict stated: "For all vacant director and assistant posts under the Gate Office of the Secretariat, follow the Tang edict of the fourth year of Tiancheng, fourth month, fourth day: the parent office must not make appointments on its own but only delegate supervision to the frontier commissioner of the vacancy; any already appointed are to be immediately ordered to cease and reported.

units.zh: 應常帶使相節度使，自楊光遠已下凡七人，並改鄉里名號。」
units.en: All military commissioners who regularly held commissioner-with-seal rank, from Yang Guangyuan down—seven in all—must change their native-place designations."
units.literal: All military commissioners who regularly hold the commissioner-with-seal rank, from Yang Guangyuan down, seven persons in all, shall change their native-place designations."

units.zh: 七月丙午朔，差左諫議大夫薛融、秘書監呂琦、駕部員外郎兼侍御史知雜事劉皞、刑部郎中司徒詡、大理正張仁彖，同共詳定唐明宗朝編敕。
units.en: On bingwu, the first day of the seventh month, Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Counselor; Lü Qi, Director of the Palace Library; Liu Hao, Transport Office Vice Director and concurrent Supervising Censor in charge of miscellaneous affairs; Situ Xu, Director in the Ministry of Punishments; and Zhang Rentuan, Senior Rectifier of the Court of Judicial Review, were jointly assigned to review and revise the compiled edicts of the Tang reign of Emperor Mingzong.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on the first day (bingwu), Xue Rong, Left Remonstrance Counselor; Lü Qi, Director of the Palace Library; Liu Hao, Director of the Transport Office and concurrent Supervising Censor with charge of mixed affairs; Situ Xu, Director of the Ministry of Punishments; and Zhang Rentuan, Senior Rectifier of the Court of Judicial Review, were jointly dispatched to examine and fix the compiled edicts of the Tang reign of Emperor Mingzong.

units.zh: 庚戌，御史中丞王延改尚書右丞，尚書右丞盧導改尚書吏部侍郎，以左諫議大夫薛融為御史中丞。
units.en: On gengxu Wang Yan moved from censor-in-chief to right vice director of the Secretariat; Lu Dao from right vice director to vice minister of personnel; and Xue Rong from left remonstrance counselor to censor-in-chief.
units.literal: On gengxu, Censor-in-Chief Wang Yan was changed to Right Vice Director of the Secretariat; Right Vice Director Lu Dao was changed to Vice Minister of Personnel; Left Remonstrance Counselor Xue Rong was appointed Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 辛酉，制皇帝受命寶，以「受天明命，惟德允昌」為文。
units.en: On xinyou the imperial Seal of Received Mandate was cast, inscribed "Receiving Heaven's clear mandate—only virtue brings lasting prosperity."
units.literal: On xinyou, the Imperial Seal of Received Mandate was cast, with the inscription "Receiving Heaven's clear mandate, virtue alone brings prosperity."

units.zh: 據《六典》，受命寶者，天子修封禪、禮神祇則用之，其始皆破皇業錢以制之。
units.en: According to the Six Institutes, the Seal of Received Mandate was used when the Son of Heaven performed the feng and shan rites or worshipped the spirits; it was originally cast by melting imperial-estate coin.
units.literal: According to the Six Institutes, the Seal of Received Mandate is used when the Son of Heaven performs feng and shan rites or worships the spirits; at the outset it was always cast by melting imperial-estate coin.

units.zh: 皇業者，藩邸主事之所有也。
units.en: Imperial-estate coin was the property held by the steward of the princely residence.
units.literal: Imperial estate coin was what the prince's residence steward held.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：天福三年六月，中書門下奏：「準敕，制皇帝受命寶。
units.en: (From the Institutes of the Five Dynasties: In the sixth month of Tianfu 3 the Secretariat-Chancellery reported: "Per edict, the Imperial Seal of Received Mandate was to be cast.
units.literal: (From the Institutes of the Five Dynasties: In the sixth month of the third year of Tianfu, the Secretariat-Chancellery reported: "Per edict, cast the Imperial Seal of Received Mandate.

units.zh: 今按唐貞觀十六年，太宗文皇帝所刻之璽，白玉為螭首，其文曰『皇帝景命，有德者昌』。」
units.en: Examining the Tang, in Zhenguan 16 Emperor Taizong had a seal carved of white jade with a dragon head, inscribed 'The emperor's bright mandate—he who has virtue prospers.'"
units.literal: Now examining the Tang, in the sixteenth year of Zhenguan Emperor Taizong the Cultured Emperor had a seal carved with white jade and a dragon head; its text read 'The Emperor's bright mandate—he who has virtue prospers.'"

units.zh: 敕：「宜以『受天明命，惟德允昌』為文刻之。」）〉
units.en: An edict ordered: "It shall be inscribed 'Receiving Heaven's clear mandate—only virtue brings lasting prosperity.'")〉
units.literal: Edict: "The inscription shall be carved as 'Receiving Heaven's clear mandate, virtue alone brings prosperity.'")〉

units.zh: 壬戌，虞部郎中、知制誥於遘改中書舍人。
units.en: On renxu Yu Gou, director of the parks office and drafting official, was reassigned as palace draftsman.
units.literal: On renxu, Yu Gou, Director of the Parks Office and Drafting Official, was changed to Palace Draftsman.

units.zh: 宰臣趙瑩、桑維翰、李崧各改鄉里名號。
units.en: The chief ministers Zhao Ying, Sang Weihan, and Li Song each changed their native-place designations.
units.literal: The chief ministers Zhao Ying, Sang Weihan, and Li Song each changed their native-place designations.

units.zh: 荊南節度使高從誨本貫汴州浚儀縣王畿鄉表節東坊，改為擁旌鄉浴鳳裏。
units.en: Gao Conghui of Jingnan, formerly registered in Biaojie East Lane, Wangji township, Junyi county, Bian prefecture, had his registration changed to Yufeng ward, Yongjing township.
units.literal: Gao Conghui, Military Commissioner of Jingnan, was natively registered in Wangji Township, Biaojie East Lane, Junyi County, Bian Prefecture; this was changed to Yufeng Ward, Yongjing Township.

units.zh: 八月戊寅，以左僕射劉句為契丹冊禮使，左散騎常侍韋勛副之，給事中盧重為契丹皇太后冊禮使。
units.en: On wuyin in the eighth month Liu Xu, left vice director, was named Khitan enfeoffment commissioner with Wei Xun, left regular attendant, as deputy; Lu Chong, drafting official-in-attendance, was named commissioner for the Khitan empress dowager.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on wuyin, Left Vice Director Liu Xu was appointed Khitan Enfeoffment Commissioner, Left Regular Attendant Wei Xun as deputy, and Drafting Official-in-Attendance Lu Chong as Khitan Empress Dowager Enfeoffment Commissioner.

units.zh: 壬午，魏府軍前奏，前澶州刺史馮暉自逆城來歸。
units.en: On renwu the Weifu army front reported that Feng Hui, former prefect of Chan, had surrendered from the rebel city.
units.literal: On renwu, the Weifu army front reported that the former Prefect of Chan, Feng Hui, had come over from the rebel city.

units.zh: 定州奏，境內旱，民多流散。
units.en: Ding prefecture reported drought within its borders and widespread displacement of the people.
units.literal: Ding Prefecture reported drought within its borders and many people scattered in flight.

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕自臨寰宇，每念生民，務切撫綏，期於富庶，屬干戈之未戢，慮徭役之或煩。
units.en: An edict said: "Since We took the realm We have constantly thought of the people, striving to comfort and pacify them and hoping for prosperity; as war has not yet ended, We fear that corvée and levies may still burden them.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Since We took the realm, We constantly think of the people, striving to soothe and pacify and hoping for wealth and plenty; as arms have not yet been laid down, We fear corvée labor may be burdensome.

units.zh: 惟彼中山，偶經夏旱，因茲疾苦，遽至流移，達我聽聞，深懷憫惻。
units.en: Zhongshan alone has suffered summer drought; hardship has driven people to flee; when this reached Our ears We were deeply moved to pity.
units.literal: That Zhongshan alone happened to suffer summer drought; through this distress people swiftly fled; reaching Our ears, We feel deep compassion.

units.zh: 應定州所差軍前夫役逃戶夏秋稅並放。」
units.en: All summer and autumn taxes owed by fugitive households in Ding for military husbands and corvée are remitted."
units.literal: All summer and autumn taxes of fugitive households levied for military husbands and corvée in Ding Prefecture are remitted."

units.zh: 甲申，襄州奏，漢江水漲一丈一尺。
units.en: On jiashen Xiang prefecture reported that the Han River had risen eleven chi.
units.literal: On jiashen, Xiang Prefecture reported the Han River had risen one zhang and one chi.

units.zh: 己丑，以前澶州刺史馮暉為檢校太保，充義成軍節度使。
units.en: On jichou Feng Hui, former prefect of Chan, was made honorary grand guardian and military commissioner of the Yicheng army.
units.literal: On jichou, the former Prefect of Chan, Feng Hui, was appointed Honorary Grand Guardian and Military Commissioner of the Yicheng Army.

units.zh: 詔：「河府、同州、絳州等三處災旱，逃移人戶下所欠累年殘稅，並今年夏稅差科，及麥苗子沿征諸色錢物等並放。
units.en: An edict declared: "In Hefu, Tong, and Jiang—the three districts stricken by disaster and drought—all arrears of residual taxes for years past owed by displaced households, this year's summer levies, and all miscellaneous charges including wheat-seed loans, were remitted.
units.literal: An edict stated: "In the three places of Hefu, Tong Prefecture, and Jiang Prefecture, afflicted by disaster and drought, all arrears of residual taxes for years past owed by displaced households, this year's summer levies and assignments, and all miscellaneous monies levied along with wheat-seed loans, are remitted.

units.zh: 其逃戶下秋苗，據見檢到數不計是元額及出剩頃畝，並放一半。
units.en: For autumn grain tax on fugitive households, half was remitted according to the acreage actually inspected, whether within the original quota or surplus.
units.literal: For autumn grain tax on fugitive households, according to the numbers actually inspected, regardless of original quota or surplus acreage, half is remitted.

units.zh: 委觀察使散行曉諭，專切招攜。
units.en: Observation commissioners were to circulate proclamations and devote themselves to summoning people back.
units.literal: Observation commissioners are charged to circulate proclamations explaining this and devote themselves to summoning and comforting returnees.

units.zh: 應歸業戶人，仍指揮逐縣切加安撫。」
units.en: Households returning to their occupations were likewise to be earnestly comforted county by county."
units.literal: For households returning to their occupations, orders are likewise given to each county to comfort them earnestly."

units.zh: 丙申，翰林學士、中書舍人竇貞固上言：「請令文武百僚，逐司之內，各奏舉一人，述其人有某能，堪為某官某職。
units.en: On bingshen Dou Zhengu, Hanlin academician and palace draftsman, proposed: "We ask that every civil and military bureau each recommend one person, stating his abilities and the office or post for which he is fit.
units.literal: On bingshen, Dou Zhengu, Hanlin Academician and Palace Draftsman, reported: "We request that civil and military officials in each bureau each memorialize one person, stating what ability he has and what office or post he is fit for.

units.zh: 據所薦否藏，定舉主黜陟。」
units.en: Promotion or demotion of the recommender shall depend on whether the nominee proves worthy."
units.literal: According to whether the recommended person succeeds or fails, determine promotion or demotion of the recommender."

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·竇貞固傳》載此疏，略云：為國之要，進賢是先。
units.en: (The Biography of Dou Zhengu in the History of Song records this memorial in summary: the essential of governing a state is to advance the worthy first.
units.literal: (The Biography of Dou Zhengu in the History of Song records this memorial, summarizing: The essential of governing a state is to advance the worthy first.

units.zh: 陛下方樹丕基，宜求多士。
units.en: Your Majesty is just laying a great foundation and should seek many able men.
units.literal: Your Majesty is just establishing a great foundation and should seek many scholars.

units.zh: 乞降詔百僚，令各司議定一人，有何能識，堪何職官，朝廷依奏用之。
units.en: We ask that an edict go to the whole bureaucracy ordering each bureau to select one person, state his abilities, and name the office for which he is fit, and that the court appoint according to the memorial.
units.literal: We beg that an edict be issued to the hundred officials ordering each bureau to deliberate and fix on one person, stating what ability and knowledge he has and what office he is fit for, and the court shall appoint according to the memorial.

units.zh: 若能符薦引，果謂當才，所奏之官，望加獎賞。
units.en: If the nominee proves worthy, the recommending office should be rewarded.
units.literal: If he matches the recommendation and proves truly fit, the office that memorialized him should receive reward.

units.zh: 如乖其舉，或涉徇私，所奏之官，宜加黜罰。
units.en: If the nominee fails the test or favoritism is involved, the recommending office should be demoted or punished.
units.literal: If he fails the recommendation or private favor is involved, the memorializing office should be demoted or punished.

units.zh: 自然官由德序，位以才升。
units.en: Then offices will naturally follow virtue in order and ranks rise by talent.
units.literal: Naturally offices will follow virtue in order and ranks rise by talent.

units.zh: 三人同行，尚聞擇善；
units.en: When three walk together, one may still hear of choosing the good;
units.literal: When three walk together, one still hears of choosing the good;

units.zh: 十目所視，必不濫知。
units.en: with ten eyes upon them, talent will surely not be misjudged.
units.literal: with ten eyes watching, knowledge will surely not be misapplied.

units.zh: 臣職在論思，敢陳狂狷。）〉
units.en: In my office of deliberation I dare offer this blunt counsel.)〉
units.literal: Your servant's duty lies in deliberation and reflection; I dare offer this blunt counsel.)〉

units.zh: 疏奏，嘉之。
units.en: The memorial was received and commended.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted, it was commended.

units.zh: 仍令文武百官於搢紳之內、草澤之中，知灼然有才器者，列名以奏。
units.en: The court also ordered civil and military officials to seek out men of clear talent among the gentry and the common people and submit their names.
units.literal: An order was also given that civil and military officials, among gentry and among commoners, should memorialize by name anyone clearly possessed of talent and ability.

units.zh: 宴契丹冊禮使於廣政殿。
units.en: The Khitan enfeoffment commissioners were feasted in Guangzheng Hall.
units.literal: A banquet was held for the Khitan enfeoffment commissioners in Guangzheng Hall.

units.zh: 戊戌，鄆州奏，陽谷縣界河決。
units.en: On wuxu Yun prefecture reported that the Yellow River had broken through its banks on the Yanggu county border.
units.literal: On wuxu, Yun Prefecture reported the Yellow River had burst its banks at the border of Yanggu County.

units.zh: 青州王建立奏，高麗國宿衛質子王仁翟乞放歸鄉里。
units.en: Wang Jianli of Qing memorialized that Wang Renzhe, a Goryeo hostage serving in the guard, asked to be sent home.
units.literal: Wang Jianli of Qing Prefecture memorialized that Wang Renzhe, a hostage guard of Goryeo serving as attendant, begged to be released to his native place.

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: It was granted.

units.zh: 辛丑，鎮、邢、定三州奏，奉詔共差樂官六十七人往契丹。
units.en: On xinchou Zhen, Xing, and Ding reported that by edict they had jointly sent sixty-seven music officers to the Khitan.
units.literal: On xinchou, Zhen, Xing, and Ding prefectures reported that per edict they had jointly dispatched sixty-seven music officers to the Khitan.

units.zh: 詔：「魏府城下，自屯軍已來，墳墓多經劚掘。
units.en: An edict said: "Below the walls of Weifu, since the army encamped there, many graves have been dug up.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Below the walls of Weifu, since the army was encamped, many tombs have been dug up.

units.zh: 雖已差人收掩，今更遣太僕卿邢德昭往伸祭奠。」
units.en: Although reburial parties have already been sent, Xing Dezhao, minister of the stud, is now dispatched to offer sacrifice and consolation."
units.literal: Though men have already been sent to reinter them, now the Minister of the Stud Xing Dezhao is further dispatched to perform sacrificial rites."

units.zh: 九月己酉，宮苑使焦繼勛自軍前押範延光牙將馬諤賫歸命請罪表到闕。
units.en: On jiyou in the ninth month Jiao Jixun, palace parks commissioner, arrived from the front escorting Ma E, a staff officer of Fan Yanguang, with the petition begging pardon.
units.literal: On jiyou in the ninth month Jiao Jixun, palace parks commissioner, arrived from the front escorting Ma E, a staff officer of Fan Yanguang, with the petition begging pardon.

units.zh: 壬子，延光領部下將士素服於本府門俟命，有詔釋罪。
units.en: On renzi Yanguang and his officers waited in plain dress at his headquarters gate; an edict pardoned them.
units.literal: On renzi, Yanguang led his subordinate officers and soldiers in plain dress at his headquarters gate awaiting orders; an edict pardoned their crimes.

units.zh: 乙卯，詔司空兼門下侍郎、平章事馮道官一品，給門戟十六枝，中書侍郎平章事桑維翰、李崧給門戟十二枝。
units.en: On yimao an edict raised Feng Dao, minister of works and grand councilor, to first rank with sixteen gate halberds; Sang Weihan and Li Song, vice directors and grand councilors, received twelve each.
units.literal: On yimao, an edict granted Minister of Works and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Councilor Feng Dao first rank, with sixteen gate halberds; Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Grand Councilors Sang Weihan and Li Song were granted twelve gate halberds each.

units.zh: 己未，宣遣靜鞭官劉守威、左金吾仗勘契官王英、司天臺雞叫學生商暉等並赴契丹。
units.en: On jiwei Liu Shouwei, Wang Ying, Shang Hui, and others were sent to the Khitan on court business.
units.literal: On jiwei, the court dispatched the quiet-whip officer Liu Shouwei, the left Golden Guard tally-inspection officer Wang Ying, the Directorate of Astronomy cock-crow student Shang Hui, and others—all to the Khitan.

units.zh: 庚申，契丹使人往洛京般取趙氏公主。
units.en: On gengshen Khitan envoys went to Luoyang to fetch Princess Zhao.
units.literal: On gengshen, Khitan envoys went to Luoyang to transport away Princess Zhao.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·趙贊傳》：德鈞父子降晉，契丹盡錮之北去，贊獨與母公主留西洛。
units.en: (The Biography of Zhao Zan in the History of Song records that when Dejun and his son surrendered to Jin the Khitan took them north in bonds; Zan alone remained in the Western Capital with his mother the princess.
units.literal: (From the Biography of Zhao Zan in the History of Song: When Dejun and his son submitted to Jin, the Khitan shackled them all and took them north; Zan alone remained in the Western Capital with his mother the princess.

units.zh: 天福三年，晉祖命贊奉母歸薊門。）〉
units.en: In Tianfu 3 the Jin founder ordered Zan to escort his mother back to Jimen.)〉
units.literal: In the third year of Tianfu, the Jin founder ordered Zan to escort his mother back to Jimen.)〉

units.zh: 襄州奏，漢江水漲三丈，出岸害稼。
units.en: Xiang prefecture reported that the Han had risen three zhang, overflowed its banks, and ruined the crops.
units.literal: Xiang Prefecture reported the Han River had risen three zhang, overflowed its banks, and damaged the crops.

units.zh: 東都奏，洛陽水漲一丈五尺，壞下浮橋。
units.en: The Eastern Capital reported that Luoyang's floodwaters rose fifteen chi and destroyed the lower pontoon bridge.
units.literal: The Eastern Capital reported Luoyang's waters had risen one zhang and five chi, destroying the lower pontoon bridge.

units.zh: 乙丑，于闐國王楊仁美遣使貢方物。
units.en: On yichou the king of Khotan, Yang Renmei, sent envoys with tribute goods.
units.literal: On yichou, King Yang Renmei of Khotan sent envoys presenting local products.

units.zh: 回鶻可汗遣使貢駝馬。
units.en: The Uyghur qaghan sent envoys with camels and horses as tribute.
units.literal: The Uyghur qaghan sent envoys presenting camels and horses.

units.zh: 丙寅，趙延壽進馬謝恩，放燕國長公主歸幽州。
units.en: On bingyin Zhao Yanshou presented horses in thanks; the Princess of Yan was released to return to Youzhou.
units.literal: On bingyin, Zhao Yanshou presented horses in thanks for grace; the Princess of Yan was released to return to Youzhou.

units.zh: 範延光差節度副使李式到闕，奉表首罪，兼進玉帶一條。
units.en: Fan Yanguang sent his deputy Li Shi to court with a confession and a jade belt.
units.literal: Fan Yanguang sent his deputy military commissioner Li Shi to court with a memorial confessing guilt and presenting one jade belt.

units.zh: 遣宣徽南院使劉處讓權知魏府軍府事。
units.en: Liu Churang of the southern palace secretariat bureau was sent to act as provisional administrator of Weifu military headquarters.
units.literal: The Southern Bureau Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat Liu Churang was dispatched with provisional authority over Weifu military headquarters affairs.

units.zh: 己巳，復範延光官爵，其制略曰：「頃朕始登大寶，未靜中原，六飛才及於京師，千里未通於懷抱。
units.en: On jisi Fan Yanguang's offices and titles were restored; the order in summary said: "When We first ascended the throne the realm was not yet settled; the court had scarcely returned to the capital and hearts far away were not yet won.
units.literal: On jisi, Fan Yanguang's offices and titles were restored; the order in summary stated: "Recently when We first ascended the great throne, the central plains were not yet tranquil; the imperial carriage had scarcely reached the capital, and hearts a thousand li away had not yet been won.

units.zh: 楚王求舊，方在遺簪；
units.en: Like the King of Chu seeking old ties, you still held to past bonds;
units.literal: The King of Chu sought his old ties, still holding to a keepsake;

units.zh: 曾子傳疑，忽成投杼。
units.en: like Zengzi's tale of doubt, suspicion suddenly took hold.
units.literal: like Zengzi passing on doubt, it suddenly became a case of casting aside the pestle.

units.zh: 尋聞悛悔，遽戮奸回，干戈俄至於經時，雷雨因思於作解。
units.en: We soon heard of your repentance and the swift punishment of traitors; though war had nearly lasted a season, We thought of mercy as of rain after thunder.
units.literal: Soon We heard of repentance; traitors were swiftly executed; arms had nearly continued for a season; thunder and rain made Us think of granting release.

units.zh: 果馳賓介，疊貢表章，向丹闕以傾心，瀝衷誠而效順。
units.en: Envoys came in haste and memorials piled up; you turned loyal hearts toward the throne and poured out sincerity in submission.
units.literal: Envoys indeed came in haste, memorials piled up, turning loyal hearts toward the scarlet gate and pouring out sincerity in submission.

units.zh: 而況保全黎庶，完整甲兵，納款斯來，其功非細。
units.en: Moreover you preserved the people and kept the army intact; your submission earned no small merit.
units.literal: Moreover you preserved the common people and kept the armor intact; your submission came—its merit is no small matter.

units.zh: 得不特頒鐵契，重建牙章，封本郡之土茅，移樂郊之旌鉞。
units.en: We therefore issued an iron covenant, rebuilt your military insignia, enfeoffed you in your commandery, and transferred your banners to a new district.
units.literal: How could We not specially issue an iron covenant and rebuild your military insignia, enfeoffing you with the soil and thatch of your commandery and transferring the banners and axes to a happier district?

units.zh: 至於將吏，鹹降絲綸。
units.en: Your officers and clerks all received imperial favors.
units.literal: As for officers and clerks, all received imperial favors.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 上穹之運四時，不愆者信；
units.en: Heaven moves through the four seasons and never fails the faithful;
units.literal: High Heaven's movement through the four seasons never errs for the faithful;

units.zh: 大道之崇三寶，所重者慈。
units.en: the Great Way exalts the Three Treasures and values compassion above all.
units.literal: the Great Way exalts the Three Treasures, and what it values is compassion.

units.zh: 活萬戶之傷夷，息六師之勞瘁。
units.en: Heal the wounded among the people; rest the weariness of the armies.
units.literal: Revive the wounded among ten thousand households; rest the weariness of the six armies.

units.zh: 遂予仁憫，旌爾變通。
units.en: We therefore grant benevolent pity and commend your change of course.
units.literal: Thus We grant benevolent pity and commend your change of course.

units.zh: 永貽子孫，長守富貴，敬佩光寵，可不美歟！
units.en: May you leave wealth and honor to your sons and grandsons forever; revere this glory—how fine a thing!
units.literal: May you forever leave this to your sons and grandsons, long keeping wealth and honor; revere this glory—how could it not be beautiful!

units.zh: 可復推誠奉義佐運致理功臣、天雄軍節度、管內觀察處置等使、開府儀同三司、守太傅、兼中書令、廣晉尹、上柱國、臨清王，食邑一萬戶，食實封一千戶，改授鄆州刺史、天平軍節度、鄆齊
units.en: He is restored as merit minister for sincerity and faith, military commissioner of Tianxiong, grand mentor and chief councilor, prince of Linqing with ten thousand households' fief income and one thousand substantive enfeoffment, and transferred to prefect of Yan, military commissioner of Tianping, over Yan and Qi
units.literal: He is fit to be restored as Merit Minister for Sincerity, Faith, Assisting the Mandate, and Ordering the Realm, Military Commissioner of the Tianxiong Army, Commissioner for Observation and Disposition within the circuit, Grand Master of the Palace with ceremonial equal to the Three Dukes, Grand Mentor, concurrent Chief Councilor, Guangjin metropolitan magistrate, Pillar of State, Prince of Linqing, with fief income of ten thousand households and substantive enfeoffment of one thousand households, and is transferred to Prefect of Yan, Military Commissioner of the Tianping Army, Yan and Qi

units.zh: 〈（原本闕一字。）〉
units.en: (One character is missing in the original text.)〉
units.literal: (The original text lacks one character.)〉

units.zh: 等州觀察處置等使，賜鐵券，改封高平郡王，仍令擇日備禮冊命。」
units.en: And other prefectures as observation commissioner, granted an iron covenant, advanced to prince of Gaoping, and ordered to choose a day for full ritual investiture."
units.literal: and other prefectures as Commissioner for Observation and Disposition, granted an iron covenant, advanced to Prince of Gaoping, and ordered to choose a day for full investiture by ritual."

units.zh: 以天雄軍節度副使、檢校刑部尚書李式檢校尚書右僕射，充亳州團練使；
units.en: Li Shi, deputy military commissioner of the Tianxiong Army and honorary Minister of Punishments, was made honorary right vice director and Bozhou training commissioner;
units.literal: Li Shi, deputy military commissioner of the Tianxiong Army and Honorary Minister of Punishments, was appointed Honorary Right Vice Director of the Secretariat and Military Training Commissioner of Bozhou;

units.zh: 以貝州刺史孫漢威為檢校太保、隴州防禦使；
units.en: Sun Hanwei, prefect of Bei, was made honorary grand guardian and Longzhou defense commissioner;
units.literal: Sun Hanwei, Prefect of Bei, was appointed Honorary Grand Guardian and Defense Commissioner of Long;

units.zh: 以天雄軍三城都巡檢使薛霸為檢校司空、衛州刺史；
units.en: Xue Ba, metropolitan inspector of Tianxiong's three cities, was made honorary minister of works and Wei prefect;
units.literal: Xue Ba, metropolitan inspector of the three cities of the Tianxiong Army, was appointed Honorary Minister of Works and Prefect of Wei;

units.zh: 以天雄軍馬步軍都指揮使五建為檢校司空、虢州刺史；
units.en: Wu Jian, horse-and-foot commander of Tianxiong, was made honorary minister of works and Guo prefect;
units.literal: Wu Jian, Commander of the Horse and Foot of the Tianxiong Army, was appointed Honorary Minister of Works and Prefect of Guo;

units.zh: 以天雄軍內外馬軍都指揮使藥元福為檢校司空、深州刺史；
units.en: Yao Yuanfu, inner and outer horse commander of Tianxiong, was made honorary minister of works and Shen prefect;
units.literal: Yao Yuanfu, Commander of the Inner and Outer Horse of the Tianxiong Army, was appointed Honorary Minister of Works and Prefect of Shen;

units.zh: 以天雄軍內外步軍都指揮使安元霸為檢校司空、隨州刺史；
units.en: An Yuanba, inner and outer foot commander of Tianxiong, was made honorary minister of works and Sui prefect;
units.literal: An Yuanba, Commander of the Inner and Outer Foot of the Tianxiong Army, was appointed Honorary Minister of Works and Prefect of Sui;

units.zh: 以天雄軍都監、前河陽行軍司馬李彥珣為檢校司空、坊州刺史。
units.en: Li Yanxun, army supervisor of Tianxiong and former Heyang army secretary, was made honorary minister of works and Fang prefect.
units.literal: Li Yanxun, Army Supervisor of the Tianxiong Army and former army secretary of Heyang, was appointed Honorary Minister of Works and Prefect of Fang.

units.zh: 李式，延光之舊僚也，其餘皆延光之將佐也，故有是命。
units.en: Li Shi was Yanguang's old colleague; the rest were his generals and aides—hence these appointments.
units.literal: Li Shi was Yanguang's old colleague; the rest were all Yanguang's generals and aides—hence these appointments.

units.zh: 庚午，遣客省使李守貞押器幣賜魏府立功將校。
units.en: On gengwu Li Shouzhen of the guest bureau was sent with vessels and silks to reward meritorious Weifu officers.
units.literal: On gengwu, Envoy of the Guest Bureau Li Shouzhen was dispatched to escort vessels and silks as gifts to meritorious officers of Weifu.

units.zh: 辛未，以魏府招討使楊光遠檢校太師、兼中書令，行廣晉尹，充天雄軍節度使。
units.en: On xinwei Yang Guangyuan, Weifu pacification commissioner, was made honorary grand preceptor and chief councilor, acting Guangjin metropolitan magistrate, and Tianxiong military commissioner.
units.literal: On xinwei, Yang Guangyuan, Pacification Commissioner of Weifu, was appointed Honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Chief Councilor, acting Guangjin metropolitan magistrate, and Military Commissioner of the Tianxiong Army.

units.zh: 十月乙亥，福建節度使王繼恭遣使貢方物。
units.en: On yihai in the tenth month Wang Jigong, Military Commissioner of Fujian, sent envoys with tribute goods.
units.literal: In the tenth month, on yihai, Wang Jigong, Military Commissioner of Fujian, sent envoys presenting local products.

units.zh: 戊寅，契丹命使以寶冊上帝徽號曰英武明義皇帝。
units.en: On wuyin Khitan envoys used precious registers to bestow on the emperor the honorific Cultured, Martial, Bright, and Righteous.
units.literal: On wuyin, Khitan envoys used precious registers to ennoble the Emperor with the honorific title Cultured, Martial, Bright, and Righteous.

units.zh: 〈（《歐陽史》作契丹使中書令韓頻來奉冊。）〉
units.en: (Ouyang Xiu's history records that the Khitan chief councilor Han Pin came to present the register.)〉
units.literal: (The Ouyang History records that Khitan envoy Chief Councilor Han Pin came to present the register.)〉

units.zh: 是日，左右金吾、六軍儀仗、太常鼓吹等並出城迎引至崇元殿前，陳列如儀。
units.en: That day the golden guards, six armies' ceremonial escort, and sacrificial musicians went out to escort them to Chongyuan Hall and arrayed them in ritual order.
units.literal: That day the Left and Right Golden Guards, the six armies' ceremonial guards, and the Directorate of Sacrifices' musicians all went out of the city to escort them to before Chongyuan Hall and arrayed them according to ritual.

units.zh: 鄆州範延光奏到任內。
units.en: Fan Yanguang of Yun reported his arrival in his jurisdiction.
units.literal: Fan Yanguang of Yun Prefecture memorialized his arrival in his jurisdiction.

units.zh: 庚辰，御劄曰：「為國之規，在於敏政；
units.en: On gengchen an imperial communication said: "The rule of governing a state lies in diligent administration;
units.literal: On gengchen, an Imperial Communication stated: "The rule of governing a state lies in diligent administration;

units.zh: 建都之法，務要利民。
units.en: the method of establishing a capital must benefit the people.
units.literal: the method of establishing a capital must benefit the people.

units.zh: 歷考前經，朗然通論，顧惟涼德，獲啟丕基。
units.en: The former classics make the theory clear; considering Our modest virtue, We have inaugurated a great foundation.
units.literal: Examining the former classics, the theory is clear; considering Our modest virtue, We have been enabled to inaugurate a great foundation.

units.zh: 當數朝戰伐之餘，是兆庶傷殘之後，車徒既廣，帑廩鹹虛。
units.en: This comes after generations of warfare and widespread suffering among the people; transport needs are vast and the treasury empty.
units.literal: This comes after generations of warfare, after the myriad people have suffered wounds; carriage teams are already broad and the treasury is empty.

units.zh: 經年之免粟飛芻，繼日而勞民動眾，常煩漕運，不給供須。
units.en: Year after year grain is remitted yet transport still strains the people; supplies constantly fall short despite ceaseless cartage.
units.literal: Year after year grain is exempted yet fodder still flies in; day after day the people are labored and the masses mobilized; transport is constantly troubled and supplies do not suffice.

units.zh: 今汴州水陸要沖，山河形勝，乃萬庾千箱之地，是四通八達之郊。
units.en: Bianzhou is a vital junction by water and land, strategically placed—a land of granaries and a crossroads in every direction.
units.literal: Now Bian Prefecture is a vital junction by water and land, with strategic mountains and rivers—it is a land of ten thousand granaries and a crossroads in every direction.

units.zh: 爰自按巡，益觀宜便，俾升都邑，以利兵民。
units.en: Since Our inspection We have seen more clearly what is fitting; the capital shall be elevated to benefit soldiers and people.
units.literal: Since Our inspection tour We have seen more clearly what is fitting; let the capital be elevated to benefit soldiers and people.

units.zh: 汴州宜升為東京，置開封府。
units.en: Bianzhou is elevated to the Eastern Capital and the Kaifeng metropolitan prefecture established.
units.literal: Bian Prefecture should be elevated to the Eastern Capital and the Kaifeng metropolitan prefecture established.

units.zh: 仍升開封、浚儀兩縣為赤縣，其餘升為畿縣。
units.en: Kaifeng and Junyi are elevated to imperial counties; the rest become metropolitan counties.
units.literal: Kaifeng and Junyi counties are both elevated to imperial counties; the rest are elevated to metropolitan counties.

units.zh: 應舊置開封府時所管屬縣，並可仍舊割屬收管，亦升為畿縣。
units.en: Counties formerly under Kaifeng when first established remain under its jurisdiction and are likewise elevated to metropolitan counties.
units.literal: All counties formerly under the Kaifeng metropolitan prefecture when it was first established may remain under its jurisdiction and are likewise elevated to metropolitan counties.

units.zh: 其洛京改為西京；
units.en: Luoyang is renamed the Western Capital;
units.literal: Luoyang is changed to the Western Capital;

units.zh: 其雍京改為晉昌軍，留守改為節度觀察使，依舊為京兆府，列在七府之上；
units.en: Yongjing becomes the Jinchang army, its regent a military commissioner, still the Jingzhao metropolitan prefecture, ranked above the seven great prefectures;
units.literal: Yongjing is changed to the Jinchang Army, its regent changed to a military commissioner for observation, still the Jingzhao metropolitan prefecture, ranked above the seven metropolitan prefectures;

units.zh: 其曹州改為防禦州。
units.en: Caozhou becomes a defense prefecture.
units.literal: Cao Prefecture is changed to a defense prefecture.

units.zh: 其餘制置，並委中書門下商量施行。」
units.en: Other arrangements are entrusted to the Secretariat-Chancellery for deliberation and implementation."
units.literal: Other arrangements are entrusted to the Secretariat-Chancellery for deliberation and implementation."

units.zh: 丙戌，以護聖左廂都指揮使、曹州刺史張彥澤為鎮國軍節度使，以工部尚書裴皞為尚書右僕射致仕。
units.en: On bingxu Zhang Yanzhe, left imperial guard commander and Cao prefect, became Zhenguo military commissioner; Pei Hao, minister of works, retired as right vice director.
units.literal: On bingxu, Zhang Yanzhe, Commander of the Left Wing of the Imperial Guard, and Prefect of Cao, was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhenguo Army; Pei Hao, Minister of Works, was granted retirement as Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 是日，詔改大寧宮門為明德門。
units.en: That day an edict renamed the Daning Palace gate the Gate of Bright Virtue.
units.literal: That day an edict changed the Daning Palace gate to the Gate of Bright Virtue.

units.zh: 又改京城諸門名額，南門尉氏以薰風為名，西二門鄭門、梁門以金義、乾明為名，北二門酸棗門、封丘門以元化、宣陽為名，東二門曹門、宋門以迎春、仁和為名。
units.en: The capital gates were also renamed: the south gate Weishi became Xunfeng; the west gates Zheng and Liang became Jinyi and Qianming; the north gates Suanzao and Fengqiu became Yuanhua and Xuanyang; the east gates Cao and Song became Yingchun and Renhe.
units.literal: The names of the capital's gates were also changed: the southern Weishi gate was named Xunfeng, the western Zheng and Liang gates were named Jinyi and Qianming, the northern Suanzao and Fengqiu gates were named Yuanhua and Xuanyang, and the eastern Cao and Song gates were named Yingchun and Renhe.

units.zh: 戊子，以右金吾大將軍馬從斌為契丹國信使，考功郎中劉知新副之。
units.en: On wuzi Ma Congbin, senior general of the Right Golden guard, was named Khitan credence commissioner with Liu Zhixin, director of merit, as deputy.
units.literal: On wuzi, Ma Congbin, Senior General of the Right Golden Guard, was appointed Khitan Credence Commissioner, with Liu Zhixin, Director of the Bureau of Merit, as deputy.

units.zh: 以前天平軍節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事安審琦為晉昌軍節度使，行京兆尹。
units.en: An Shenqi, former Tianping military commissioner and honorary Grand Commandant, was made Jinchang military commissioner and acting metropolitan governor of Jingzhao.
units.literal: An Shenqi, former Military Commissioner of the Tianping Army, Honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Grand Councilor, was appointed Military Commissioner of the Jinchang Army, acting Metropolitan Governor of Jingzhao.

units.zh: 襄州奏，江水漲害稼。
units.en: Xiang prefecture reported flood damage to the crops.
units.literal: Xiang Prefecture reported the river waters had risen and damaged the crops.

units.zh: 壬辰，以樞密使、中書侍郎平章事、集賢殿大學士桑維翰兼兵部尚書，皆罷樞密使。
units.en: On renchen Sang Weihan, Privy Councilor, Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Advancing Worthies, was also made Minister of War; all were removed as Privy Councilors.
units.literal: On renchen, Sang Weihan—Privy Councilor, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for Advancing Worthies—was additionally appointed Minister of War; all were removed as Privy Councilors.

units.zh: 〈（案：以上疑有闕文。
units.en: (Note: The text above is suspected of lacuna.
units.literal: (Note: The text above is suspected of lacuna.

units.zh: 據《通鑒考異》引《晉高祖實錄》，維翰與李崧並罷樞密使。）〉
units.en: According to the Comprehensive Mirror's examination of differences citing Gaozu's veritable record, Weihan and Li Song were both removed as privy councilors.)〉
units.literal: According to the Examination of Differences in the Comprehensive Mirror citing the Veritable Record of Emperor Gaozu of Jin, Weihan and Li Song were both removed as Privy Councilors.)〉

units.zh: 戊戌，大赦天下，以魏府初平故也。
units.en: On wuxu a general amnesty was proclaimed because Weifu had just been pacified.
units.literal: On wuxu a general amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven, because Weifu had just been pacified.

units.zh: 庚子，楊光遠朝覲到闕，對於便殿，錫賫甚厚。
units.en: On gengzi Yang Guangyuan came to court and was received in the side hall with very generous gifts.
units.literal: On gengzi, Yang Guangyuan came to court and was received in the side hall; gifts were very generous.

units.zh: 于闐國王李聖天冊封為大寶于闐國王。
units.en: Li Sheng Tian, king of Khotan, was enfeoffed as king of the Great Treasure State of Khotan.
units.literal: Li Sheng Tian, King of Khotan, was enfeoffed as King of the Great Treasure State of Khotan.

units.zh: 以杭州嘉興縣為秀州，從錢元瓘之奏也。
units.en: Jiaxing county of Hang was established as Xiu prefecture at Qian Yuanguan's request.
units.literal: Jiaxing County of Hang Prefecture was established as Xiu Prefecture, following Qian Yuanguan's memorial.

units.zh: 十一月甲辰，樞密直學士、祠部員外郎吳涓進金部郎中、知制誥，樞密直學士、庫部員外郎吳承範進祠部郎中、知制誥。
units.en: On jiachen in the eleventh month Wu Juan, Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Director of the Bureau of Sacrifices, was promoted to Director of the Bureau of Metals and drafting official, and Wu Chengfan, Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Director of the Armory Bureau, to Director of the Bureau of Sacrifices and drafting official.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiachen, Wu Juan, Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Director of the Bureau of Sacrifices, was promoted to Director of the Bureau of Metals and Drafting Official; Wu Chengfan, Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Director of the Armory Bureau, was promoted to Director of the Bureau of Sacrifices and Drafting Official.

units.zh: 乙巳，鄆州範延光來朝。
units.en: On yisi Fan Yanguang of Yun came to court.
units.literal: On yisi, Fan Yanguang of Yun Prefecture came to court.

units.zh: 丙午，封閩王昶為閩國王，加食邑一萬五千戶。
units.en: On bingwu Prince Chang of Min was enfeoffed as king of Min with fifteen thousand additional households' fief income.
units.literal: On bingwu, Prince Chang of Min was enfeoffed as King of Min, with fief income increased by fifteen thousand households.

units.zh: 又以中吳建武等軍節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、蘇州誠州刺史錢元尞為太傅，以清海軍節度使、廣州刺史錢元璹為檢校太尉、兼中書令，仍改名元懿。
units.en: Qian Yuankuan of Zhongwu and Jianwu was made grand mentor; Qian Yuanshan of Qinghai was made honorary Grand Commandant and chief councilor and renamed Yuanyi.
units.literal: Qian Yuankuan, Military Commissioner of the Zhongwu and Jianwu armies, Honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrent Chief Councilor, and Prefect of Suzhou and Cheng, was appointed Grand Mentor; Qian Yuanshan, Military Commissioner of the Qinghai Army and Prefect of Guang, was appointed Honorary Grand Commandant and concurrent Chief Councilor, and his name was changed to Yuanyi.

units.zh: 應有魏府行營將校及六軍諸道、本城將校等，並與加恩。
units.en: Officers of the Weifu field headquarters, six armies, circuits, and capital garrisons likewise received favors.
units.literal: All officers of the Weifu field headquarters and of the six armies, circuits, and capital garrisons likewise received favors.

units.zh: 戊申，以門下侍郎平章事、監修國史、判戶部趙瑩兼吏部尚書。
units.en: Zhao Ying, vice director of the chancellery, grand councilor, historiography supervisor, and revenue overseer, was also made minister of personnel.
units.literal: Zhao Ying, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor, Supervisor of the National History, and overseer of the Ministry of Revenue, was additionally appointed Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 以威武軍節度、福建管內觀察處置等使王繼恭為特進、檢校太傅，仍封臨海郡王。
units.en: Wang Jigong of Weiwu and Fujian was made specially advanced honorary grand mentor and prince of Linhai.
units.literal: Wang Jigong, Military Commissioner of the Weiwu Army and Commissioner for Observation and Disposition within Fujian, was appointed Special Advancement and Honorary Grand Mentor, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai.

units.zh: 以魏博節度使楊光遠為守太尉、洛京留守，兼河陽節度使，判六軍諸衛事。
units.en: Yang Guangyuan of Weibo was made acting grand commandant, Luoyang regent, concurrent Heyang military commissioner, and overseer of the six armies and palace guards.
units.literal: Yang Guangyuan, Military Commissioner of Weibo, was appointed acting Grand Commandant, Regent of Luoyang, concurrent Military Commissioner of Heyang, and overseer of the six armies and palace guards.

units.zh: 端明殿學士、尚書禮部侍郎、判度支和凝改尚書戶部侍郎充職。
units.en: He Ning, Duanming academician, vice minister of rites, and revenue overseer, was reassigned as vice minister of revenue.
units.literal: He Ning, Academician of the Duanming Hall, Vice Minister of Rites, and overseer of revenue, was changed to Vice Minister of Revenue to fill the post.

units.zh: 庚戌，鄆州範延光上表乞休退，詔不允。
units.en: On gengxu Fan Yanguang of Yun begged to retire; the edict refused.
units.literal: On gengxu, Fan Yanguang of Yun Prefecture submitted a memorial begging to retire; the edict did not grant it.

units.zh: 辛亥，升廣晉府為鄴都，置留守。
units.en: On xinhai Guangjin prefecture was elevated to the Ye metropolitan district with a regent appointed.
units.literal: On xinhai, Guangjin Prefecture was elevated to the metropolitan district of Ye, with a regent appointed.

units.zh: 升廣晉、元城兩縣為赤縣，屬府諸縣升為畿縣。
units.en: Guangjin and Yuancheng became imperial counties; prefectural counties became metropolitan counties.
units.literal: Guangjin and Yuancheng counties were elevated to imperial counties; counties under the prefecture were elevated to metropolitan counties.

units.zh: 升相州為彰德軍，置節度觀察使，以澶、衛二州為屬郡，其澶州仍升為防禦州，移於德勝口為治所。
units.en: Xiangzhou was elevated to the Zhangde army with an observation commissioner; Chan and Wei became subordinate prefectures; Chan was elevated to a defense prefecture with its seat moved to Desheng Ford.
units.literal: Xiang Prefecture was elevated to the Zhangde Army, with a military commissioner for observation appointed; Chan and Wei prefectures were made subordinate prefectures; Chan was further elevated to a defense prefecture and its seat moved to Desheng Ford.

units.zh: 升貝州為永清軍，置節度觀察使，以博、冀二州為屬郡。
units.en: Beizhou was elevated to the Yongqing army with an observation commissioner; Bo and Ji became subordinate prefectures.
units.literal: Bei Prefecture was elevated to the Yongqing Army, with a military commissioner for observation appointed; Bo and Ji prefectures were made subordinate prefectures.

units.zh: 以西京留守高行周為廣晉尹、鄴都留守；
units.en: Gao Xingzhou, regent of the Western Capital, was made Guangjin metropolitan magistrate and regent of Ye;
units.literal: Gao Xingzhou, Regent of the Western Capital, was appointed Guangjin metropolitan magistrate and Regent of Ye;

units.zh: 廣晉府行營中軍使、貝州防禦使王庭允加檢校太傅，充相州彰德軍節度使；
units.en: Wang Tingyun, Guangjin middle army commissioner and Bei defense commissioner, was made honorary grand mentor and Zhangde military commissioner at Xiang;
units.literal: Wang Tingyun, Middle Army Commissioner of the Guangjin Field Headquarters and Defense Commissioner of Bei, was promoted to Honorary Grand Mentor and Military Commissioner of the Zhangde Army at Xiang;

units.zh: 廣晉府行營步軍都指揮使、右神武統軍王周為貝州永清軍節度使。
units.en: Wang Zhou, Guangjin foot commander and Right Shenwu commander, was made Yongqing military commissioner at Bei.
units.literal: Wang Zhou, Commander of the Foot Soldiers of the Guangjin Field Headquarters and Commander of the Right Shenwu Army, was appointed Military Commissioner of the Yongqing Army at Bei.

units.zh: 甲寅，以範延光為太子太師致仕。
units.en: On jiayin Fan Yanguang retired as grand mentor of the heir apparent.
units.literal: On jiayin, Fan Yanguang was granted retirement as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 丙辰，以秘書監呂琦為禮部侍郎，歸德軍節度使趙在禮改天平軍節度使，昭義軍節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都虞候杜重威改忠武軍節度使，忠武軍節度使、侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使劉知遠改歸德軍節度使，前河陽節度使兼奉國左右廂都指揮使侯益改昭義軍節度使。
units.en: On bingchen Lü Qi, palace library director, became vice minister of rites; Zhao Zaili of Guide became Tianping military commissioner; Du Chongwei of Zhaoyi became Zhongwu military commissioner; Liu Zhiyuan of Zhongwu became Guide military commissioner; and Hou Yi, former Heyang commissioner, became Zhaoyi military commissioner.
units.literal: On bingchen, Lü Qi, Director of the Palace Library, was appointed Vice Minister of Rites; Zhao Zaili, Military Commissioner of the Guide Army, was changed to Military Commissioner of the Tianping Army; Du Chongwei, Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi and Chief Adjutant of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, was changed to Military Commissioner of the Zhongwu Army; Liu Zhiyuan, Military Commissioner of the Zhongwu Army and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot, was changed to Military Commissioner of the Guide Army; Hou Yi, former Military Commissioner of Heyang and Commander of the Left and Right Wings of the Fengguo Army, was changed to Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi.

units.zh: 癸亥，割濮州濮陽縣棣澶州。
units.en: On guihai Puyang county was detached from Puzhou and attached to Chanzhou.
units.literal: On guihai, Puyang County of Pu Prefecture was detached and attached to Chan Prefecture.

units.zh: 詔許天下私鑄錢，以「天福元寶」為文。
units.en: An edict permitted private coinage throughout the realm, inscribed "Tianfu Yuanbao."
units.literal: An edict permitted private coinage throughout the realm, with the inscription "Tianfu Yuanbao."

units.zh: 丙寅冬至，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。
units.en: On bingyin, the winter solstice, the emperor entered Chongyuan Hall for court congratulations, with guards and ceremonial escorts in full order.
units.literal: On bingyin, the winter solstice, the Emperor took the throne in Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and escorts followed the prescribed form.

units.zh: 十二月甲戌朔，以前兵部尚書梁文矩為太子太師，以鎮州節度副使符蒙為右諫議大夫，以吏部郎中曹國珍為左諫議大夫。
units.en: On the first day of the twelfth month Liang Wenju, former minister of war, became grand mentor of the heir apparent; Fu Meng, Zhen deputy commissioner, became right remonstrance counselor; and Cao Guozhen, personnel director, became left remonstrance counselor.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day (jiaxu), Liang Wenju, former Minister of War, was appointed Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Fu Meng, Deputy Military Commissioner of Zhen, was appointed Right Remonstrance Counselor; Cao Guozhen, Director in the Ministry of Personnel, was appointed Left Remonstrance Counselor.

units.zh: 丙子，以前涇州彰義軍節度使李德充為晉州建雄軍節度使，加同平章事。
units.en: On bingzi Li Dechong, former Zhangyi commissioner at Jing, became Jianxiong military commissioner at Jin and concurrent grand councilor.
units.literal: On bingzi, Li Dechong, former Military Commissioner of the Zhangyi Army at Jing, was appointed Military Commissioner of the Jianxiong Army at Jin, with concurrent Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 以皇太子右金吾衛上將軍重貴為檢校太傅、開封尹，封鄭王，加食邑三千戶。
units.en: Chonggui, the heir apparent and senior general of the Right Golden Guard, was made honorary grand mentor and Kaifeng metropolitan magistrate, enfeoffed as prince of Zheng, with three thousand additional households' fief income.
units.literal: Chonggui, the Heir Apparent and Senior General of the Right Golden Guard, was appointed Honorary Grand Mentor and Kaifeng metropolitan magistrate, enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng, with fief income increased by three thousand households.

units.zh: 戊寅，制以大寶于闐國進奉使、檢校太尉馬繼榮為鎮國大將軍，使副黃門將軍、國子少監張再通為試衛尉卿，監使殿頭承旨、通事舍人吳順規為試將作少監。
units.en: On wuyin, Ma Jirong, presenting envoy of the Great Treasure State of Khotan and honorary Grand Commandant, was made Grand General Who Guards the State; deputy envoy Zhang Zaitong, Yellow Gate General and Vice Director of the Directorate of Education, was made acting Chamberlain of the Court of the Imperial Insignia; and supervising envoy Wu Shungui, Palace Head Director of Audience and Drafting Master of Ceremonies, was made acting Vice Director of Palace Buildings.
units.literal: An order on wuyin appointed Ma Jirong, presenting envoy of the Great Treasure State of Khotan and honorary Grand Commandant, as Grand General Who Guards the State; Zhang Zaitong, Deputy Envoy, Yellow Gate General, and Vice Director of the Directorate of Education, as Acting Chamberlain of the Court of the Imperial Insignia; and Wu Shungui, supervising envoy, Palace Head Director of Audience, and Drafting Master of Ceremonies, as Acting Vice Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings.

units.zh: 回鶻使都督李萬金可歸義大將軍，監使雷德順為順化將軍。
units.en: The Uyghur envoy Li Wanjin was made grand general of righteous submission; supervising envoy Lei Deshun was made general of harmonious transformation.
units.literal: Uyghur envoy Commissioner Li Wanjin was made Grand General of Righteous Submission; supervising envoy Lei Deshun was made General of Harmonious Transformation.

units.zh: 是日，詔：「宜令天下無問公私，應有銅欲鑄錢者，一任取便酌量輕重鑄造。」
units.en: That day an edict declared: "Throughout the realm, public or private, anyone with copper who wished to cast coin might do so at convenience, determining weight as they saw fit."
units.literal: That day an edict stated: "Let all under Heaven, public and private alike, whoever has copper wishing to cast coin, be permitted at convenience to determine weight and cast as they see fit."

units.zh: 戊子，以河陽潛龍舊宅為開晉禪院，邢州潛龍舊宅為廣法禪院。
units.en: On wuzi the former hidden-dragon residence at Heyang became the Kaijin Chan monastery, and that at Xing the Guangfa Chan monastery.
units.literal: On wuzi, the former hidden-dragon residence at Heyang was made the Kaijin Chan Monastery, and the hidden-dragon residence at Xing was made the Guangfa Chan Monastery.

units.zh: 龍武統軍李從昶卒，輟朝一日，贈太尉。
units.en: Li Congchang, Dragon Martial commander, died; court audiences were suspended for one day, and he was posthumously granted grand commandant.
units.literal: Li Congchang, Commander of the Dragon Martial Army, died; court audiences were suspended for one day; he was posthumously granted Grand Commandant.
